newsitem.title: INDIA: India bus accident kills at least 14, injures 13.
newsitem.headline: India bus accident kills at least 14, injures 13.

text.p: At least 14 people were killed and 13 injured after a bus collided with a truck on a highway in India's northeastern state of Assam, police said on Monday.

The accident occurred late on Sunday near Bokakhat, 75 km (46 miles) east of the state's main commercial city Guwahati, when the bus carrying 30 passengers collided with a truck headed in the opposite direction, a senior police official said.
An estimated 50,000 people die each year in India in road accidents.
